messages:
lina (Marketing): Uploaded a fresh draft of the launch post: https://drive.redwood/launch-v2. Need a fast pass on 3 things: 1) main audience hooks (PMs vs infra), 2) safe benchmark copy, 3) webinar CTA routing. Can you skim and flag must-fix items pls? :eyes:

omar (Product): Skimming. My take: open with a single-sentence value prop for PMs, then a clear infra callout with benchmark highlights. Two CTA paths (PM vs infra) is cleaner.

kevin (Growth): Agree on one form + hidden segment field. Suggest using ?seg=pm or ?seg=infra and single HubSpot form that tags accordingly. I can share workflow IDs after we lock copy.

nina (Design): If we have two audience paths I can make a hero that swaps text + small visual shift based on seg param. Will also prep a compact table mapping features->buyer.

rachel (Legal): Avoid absolutes. Use "up to" and include benchmark link + methodology. Dont imply guaranteed cost savings. Add a one-line disclaimer under any numeric claim.

lina (Marketing): Omar, can you draft the 2-line PM opener? Kevin, paste the HubSpot snippet. Rachel, I'll add the disclaimer.

omar (Product): PM opener: "Move faster with LLM features  Redwood abstracts serving so product teams ship conversation features and monitoring in days, not months." Benchmark line (infra): "In internal tests, Redwood reduced per-token latency by up to 25% vs a standard A100 baseline and lowered per-request GPU cost by up to 30% (see methodology)."

rachel (Legal): That's fine provided you link the internal benchmark doc and have a brief "How we tested" note (model family, seq len, infra). Also add: "Results may vary by workload and deployment."

kevin (Growth): HubSpot form snippet (single form, hidden segment): `<form action="https://forms.hubspot.com/submit/xyz"><input type="hidden" name="seg" value="__SEG__"><input name="email" type="email"/><button>Register</button></form>` Use URL param replace. Workflows: PM -> wf_204_pm_launch, Infra -> wf_204_infra_launch. Tag: launch2026_groupA.

nina (Design): Webinars seats = 200. Kevin, can seat-bot flip CTA to "Join waitlist" at 180? Ill make the waitlist CTA red.

seat-bot: Config updated: threshold=180, cap=200. Will post counts at 150, 180, 200.

lina (Marketing): Great. I'll add the methodology link and the disclaimer line, update the hero variants, fold in the HubSpot snippet, and re-upload by EOD. If no blockers we'll hand to comms for copy lock tomorrow morning. :rocket:
